resume_flag: onPause retains existing m_bResumePlayback=true intent after callback; not proof player paused. onResume separately checks IsPlaying/HasVideo/IsPaused, then action remains refused while checkpoint active.
result_contract: GUI_ACTION receiver does not call SetResult; SendMsg default remains -1. OnAction true means handled/refused, not successful playback.
no_new_state_publication: No native callback, playback state publication, guard, checkpoint receipt or termination method modified.
required_android_check: Observe actual callbacks return without publishing a playback transition; host peer and source inspection are not JNI/device execution.
